review: Expensive for a pair of rubber clogs.
The most comfortable shoes I've ever worn, like walking on a cushion.
Sizes run large, but the heel strap keeps them secure.
Very slippery on wet tiles, I almost fell twice.
I wear them all day at the hospital and my feet never hurt.
Easy to clean, just rinse them with water.
Comfortable, but the look is not for everyone.
Light and easy to slip on, perfect for the monsoon.
The Jibbitz charms are fun, my kids love decorating them.
Not great for long walks, there's no arch support.
Delivery was quick and they were exactly as shown.
My feet get sweaty in them on hot days.
The strap came loose after a few months.
Lots of colour options, I bought the navy and the sage.
Durable, my last pair lasted almost three years.
Ugly but so comfortable, I don't care what anyone says.
